format: complete provider-native request/response bodies with deterministic privacy sentinels

sanitizer.source: Only gate public_request.body and public_response.body are copied; headers, authorization, host, and test-hop wrappers are excluded.
sanitizer.preserved: Every original body field, array position, null/empty value, number, timestamp, usage value, stop/context value, instruction, diagnostic, provider result, and error remains present and unchanged unless named below.
sanitizer.replacement_rule: Replacements retain the original JSON type and field name. Repeated original values reuse the same deterministic sentinel within a capture; correlated Claude server-tool IDs therefore remain equal.
sanitizer.ciphertext_note: Encrypted sentinels are fixture-only shape placeholders, not provider replay tokens or continuation credentials.
sanitizer.public_content_note: Public NASA result URLs, snippets, titles, and citation annotations are kept byte-for-value unchanged, including public source contact details.
sanitizer.parity_note: Each request.shape.json and response.shape.json records the complete original JSON field/type/array shape. Metadata hashes bind raw captured bodies, sanitized-source values, and fixture bytes.
